root_cause.text: The `pdm_stream_instance` structure (rtd) is allocated during stream open but not freed in the close function, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `kfree(rtd);` in `acp_pdm_dma_close` to free the previously allocated `pdm_stream_instance`, which was missing.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The `pdm_stream_instance` structure (rtd) is allocated during stream open but not freed in the close function, causing a memory leak.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds `kfree(rtd);` in `acp_pdm_dma_close` to free the previously allocated `pdm_stream_instance`, which was missing.

intent_record.intent_summary: Free the per-stream private data structure on stream close to prevent memory leak.
intent_record.what: Added a local variable rtd initialized to substream->runtime->private_data and called kfree(rtd) before returning in the close function.
intent_record.how: When the PDM DMA stream is closed, the per-stream private data structure is freed, preventing a memory leak that would occur if the allocated memory was not deallocated.

grouping_result.intent: Free the per-stream private data structure on stream close to prevent memory leak.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly adds a free of the per-stream private data structure on stream close, which is exactly what is missing according to the root cause.

candidates.rationale: The statement sets the pointer to the allocated private data structure to NULL without freeing the memory, causing a memory leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement sets the pointer to the allocated per-stream private data structure to NULL without first freeing it, causing a memory leak on stream close.

bic_trace_step.reason: In acp_pdm_dma_open(), memory is allocated for pdm_stream_instance via kzalloc() and assigned to runtime->private_data. In acp_pdm_dma_close(), there is no kfree() to release that memory, causing a memory leak. The fix would be to add 'kfree(substream->runtime->private_data);' in the close function.
